name: Zapier
tagline: Workflow automation with AI agents and chatbots
description: Zapier connects apps into automated workflows and offers AI agents and chatbots as add-ons, with plans measured in monthly tasks.
strengths: Free plan with 100 tasks per month
limitations: Prices rise with the task tier
Agent and chatbot add-ons are priced separately from the task pool

plans.name: Professional
plans.billing: From the 750-task tier; tiers run to 2,000,000 tasks per month

plans.name: Team
plans.billing: From the 2,000-task tier; tiers run to 2,000,000 tasks per month

pricing.trial: 14-day Professional trial for new accounts, no credit card required.

api.summary: AI add-ons are separate from the task pool: Agents (400 activities per month free, 1,500 on Pro, from about $33.33 per month billed annually) and Chatbots (2 free; about 5 at $13.33 or 20 at $66.67 per month billed annually).

pricing.regional: Prices are set in USD and can be billed in 19 local currencies; non-USD charges convert at the exchange rate at payment. Tax treatment: not stated.

verification.notes: Product active. Page has Pay monthly / Pay yearly (save 33%) and a task tier selector; the figures read are 'starting from': Free $0 (100 tasks a month), Professional from $19.99/month, Team from $69/month (25 users, SAML SSO), Enterprise by sales. They match the stored annual prices; the stored monthly prices ($29.99, $103.50) were not re-seen.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: Connect AI to the apps your business already uses

capabilities.title: Connect AI to your apps
capabilities.text: Zapier links assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT to more than 9,000 apps through MCP, or lets you build custom AI apps with its SDK.

capabilities.title: Let agents act across your tools
capabilities.text: Agents can score leads, process documents, route tickets and handle requests.

capabilities.title: Control what AI can do
capabilities.text: Action Restrictions, Domain Restrictions and App Access Controls limit where AI can act.

capabilities.title: See what happened
capabilities.text: Asset History, AI Guardrails and Log Streaming to tools such as Datadog or Splunk give visibility.

featureCards.name: MCP and the Zapier SDK
featureCards.text: Two ways to connect AI to the apps Zapier supports.

featureCards.name: Bring Your Own Model
featureCards.text: Use your own model, including through Amazon Bedrock.

featureCards.name: Workspaces and role-based access
featureCards.text: Give each team its own workspace and set who can do what.

featureCards.name: Security and compliance
featureCards.text: The site lists SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, GDPR and CCPA compliance, plus SSO, SCIM and VPC Peering.

audienceDetail.text: Teams that want to automate routine work across the apps they already use.
The control, visibility and security features are aimed at people who govern AI use.
The SDK and MCP let developers build custom AI apps.

scenarios.title: Score and route leads
scenarios.text: Have an agent score new leads and send them to the right person.

scenarios.title: Handle support tickets
scenarios.text: Route and resolve tickets with AI; customers on the site report large numbers resolved automatically.

scenarios.title: Process documents
scenarios.text: Pull information out of documents and pass it to the next app.

gettingStarted.text: Use the Start free button to sign up.
Choose the apps you want to link; the site says setup takes minutes.
Talk to sales about control and governance features.
